title: solidago arguta subsp. harrisii
intro: Solidago arguta subsp. harrisii, commonly known as Harris's goldenrod, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used for its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which offer relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Harris's goldenrod include its ability to treat digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
